definitions.full: H252. ach [ אַח ] noun masculine brother ; — plural suffix אחיך Kt (? יִַ֯֫ךְ K § 53, 2, Anm. b )), אֶחָךְ Qr (K § 63 ) Ezra 7:18 thy brethren , i.e. fellows, associates. [ אַחֲוָיָה ] see [ חוה ]. [ אֲחִידָה ] see חוד .
